title: Config switch: serve the last-resort KeyPackage once (protocol-07 §5.2) or again (mls-extensions-11 §6.4)
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Before the interop day. Today the server serves a last-resort KeyPackage more than once. protocol-07 §5.2: key material from one response MUST NOT appear in another; mls-extensions-11 §6.4: a last-resort KeyPackage MAY be used more than once. Add a server setting, default per protocol-07 §5.2 (once). WG item: raise the conflict (filed separately).
